items.decision_note: REQ_PETMEDS_TOTAL_ORDERS_METRIC relies on an ambiguous short acceptance; review message 47 to determine whether PetMeds was explicitly included and whether message 48 establishes a requirement rather than actual availability.

unresolved_candidate.description: The text establishes replacement of Fishwife Funnel Data ALL while retaining other sources, but does not fully resolve whether Fishwife_DataStudio_data should be used exclusively across the dashboard or only where the removed source was used.
The phrase 'both dashboard data sources' may establish total-orders availability for both Fishwife and PetMeds, but the exact two sources referenced are not named in the acceptance exchange.

PetMeds is reported to lack most of the Fishwife metric list, but the exact missing metrics are never enumerated, so additional PetMeds metric Requirements cannot be safely discovered from this exchange.
The Impact page's hidden and disabled behavior is clear, but the messages do not explicitly identify whether the page belongs to the Fishwife or PetMeds dashboard.
